svg.title: The stabilized one-sided repair has no internal exchange
svg.desc: An internal unitary fixes N1, the ambient commutant. It would transfer a normal expectation from P1 join N1 to Q1 join N1. Restriction would yield an impossible normal expectation from B of ell squared Delta onto its left regular group algebra. Equal masses of infinitely many diagonal projections are zero, contradicting normality at the identity. This concerns the displayed repair, not every possible pair.

g.text: Stabilization does not repair the internal exchange
Theorem 5F.3 · Γ, Δ as in Section 5A · HΓ = ℓ²Γ, HΔ = ℓ²Δ
M₁ = B(L) ⊗ B(L) ⊗ B(HΓ) ⊗ RΔ
N₁ = M₁′ = 1 ⊗ 1 ⊗ 1 ⊗ ℒΔ
U ∈ M₁ ⇒ Un = nU for every n ∈ N₁
P₁ ∨ N₁
B(L) ⊗ 1 ⊗ ℒΓ ⊗ ℒΔ
Normal Fₚ onto N₁ exists:
compress at ξ₁ ⊗ ξ₂ ⊗ δₑ
Q₁ ∨ N₁
1 ⊗ B(L) ⊗ RΓ ⊗ B(HΔ)
A normal FQ would follow if
an internal U exchanged P₁, Q₁.
P₁′ ∩ M₁ = Q₁, Q₁′ ∩ M₁ = P₁, and P₁ ∨ Q₁ = M₁
These three properties hold; the internal-unitary clause fails.
Lemma 5F.2: FQ(x) = Fₚ(U* x U)
Restrict to the last coordinate in Q₁ ∨ N₁:
EΔ : B(HΔ) → ℒΔ would be a normal conditional expectation.
Lemma 5F.1: the diagonal masses contradict normality
ψ = τΔ ∘ EΔ; p₍g₎ = λg p₍e₎ λg*; ψ(p₍g₎) = t for every g ∈ Δ.
|F| t ≤ 1 for every finite F ⊂ Δ ⇒ t = 0, since Δ is infinite.
Σ₍g∈Fₙ₎ p₍g₎ ↑ 1 ⇒ 1 = ψ(1) = limₙ |Fₙ| t = 0.
Conclusion: no U ∈ M₁ has UP₁U* = Q₁.
Exact proofs: Lemmas 5F.1–5F.2 and Theorem 5F.3; spatial tensors in the formulas.
Human-source target: Connes, Corollary 11, author PDF 44–45. General existence stays open.
